name: Capture
summary: Capture a screen region, annotate it, and attach it to an agent prompt. On the iPhone, long-press any blank area to select, mark up and copy part of the screen.

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Read the screen region you explicitly select
Add the accepted image to the local prompt composer
Copy the area you select on the phone to the clipboard

screenshots.alt: Capture annotation window with drawing tools and an Add to Prompt action
